verdict.rationale: Motion's docs explicitly say it combines Outlook, Google and iCloud calendar accounts into one interface. Its booking and scheduling features (bookable time slots, daily meeting limits that make the calendar unbookable, automatic reshuffling) imply it reads availability across those calendars. However, no evidence explicitly states that every connected calendar is checked for conflicts to prevent double-booking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-calendar conflict detection and double-booking prevention, and independent or hands-on corroboration that busy times on all connected calendars are respected.
